description: Offline MIT-licensed safety blocklist of critical Android, Google, and OEM packages that must never be uninstalled by automated optimization flows.

android.reason: Core Android framework-res package. Removing bricks the OS.

com.android.systemui.reason: System UI (status bar, navigation bar, lockscreen, notifications). Immediate crash/bootloop if removed.

com.android.settings.reason: Device Settings application. Needed to configure USB debugging, Wi-Fi, and apps.

com.android.phone.reason: Core cellular telephony and SIM radio service. Causes persistent crashes/bootloops.

com.android.server.telecom.reason: Core call routing and Telecom framework.

com.android.shell.reason: ADB shell host UID. Removing breaks ADB itself.

com.android.packageinstaller.reason: Handles APK installation and runtime permission dialogs.

com.google.android.packageinstaller.reason: Google Package Installer and permission UI.

com.android.documentsui.reason: System file picker required by apps for storage access.

com.google.android.documentsui.reason: Google Files / system document picker required by apps.

com.android.keychain.reason: System credential storage and TLS client certificates.

com.android.webview.reason: System WebView renderer used by almost all Android apps.

com.google.android.gms.reason: Google Play Services. Removing breaks Play Store, notifications, location, and banking Play Integrity.

com.google.android.gsf.reason: Google Services Framework required by Play Services and Play Store.

com.android.vending.reason: Google Play Store and Play Integrity verification.

com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.reason: Gboard default keyboard. Never remove unless another keyboard is verified active.

com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher.reason: Pixel Launcher. Removing without an active replacement leaves the device unusable.

com.miui.securitycenter.reason: Critical MIUI/HyperOS security & permission daemon. Removing causes an immediate bootloop into Recovery.

com.xiaomi.finddevice.reason: Critical Xiaomi Find Device daemon. Removing causes a hard bootloop on MIUI/HyperOS.

com.miui.home.reason: MIUI System Launcher and recents provider.

com.sec.android.app.launcher.reason: Samsung One UI Home launcher and recents integration.

com.samsung.android.honeyboard.reason: Samsung Keyboard. Do not remove without a verified active replacement IME.

com.samsung.android.knox.containercore.reason: Samsung Knox core needed for Secure Folder and Work Profile.

com.oplus.battery.reason: Core OPlus battery & power policy service.
